prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Mercury (수은) itself — the sovereign of the Mercury Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a sharp, striking, intense look; porcelain-pale skin; oval face; medium-sized eyes — narrow upturned eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; sharp angled brows; straight narrow nose; full heart-shaped lips; cinnabar-red eyes; a soft rose-red tint on the lips.
Body and hair: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; glossy chin-length finger waves with no bangs, forehead bare; flowing liquid-quicksilver hair beading into mirror droplets at the tips.
Hair: her hair is worn exactly as described above — loose, long or cut as named; do not pin it up into a bun or tuck it under goggles or a hat unless the hair above is an updo.
Expression: a small sly smile, bright eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: mercury: the only metal that is liquid at room temperature — quicksilver that pools, beads into round mirror droplets and rolls away from any touch; born from blood-red cinnabar ore, the vermilion of lacquer and seal paste; the living metal of the alchemists, named for Mercury the winged messenger god; the silver column rising in thermometers and barometers, the tin amalgam behind old mirrors; beautiful but poisonous, quick and capricious.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — STEAMPUNK
Costume: late-Victorian industrial dress — a high-necked blouse with a waistcoat or a tailored tail coat, leather gloves, a work apron or utility belt with brass fittings, goggles hung at the neck or a small instrument as ornament; below, a short bustle skirt and laced boots; the traits above as colour accents. No crown unless the opening line says she wears one; steam, pipes and gauges in the scene.
Silhouette: a long tailcoat over a waistcoat, a small silk top hat and a pocket-watch chain — a gentleman inventor's upright shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: flowing quicksilver silver, cinnabar vermilion red, glossy lacquer black, a glint of mercury-lamp blue-violet.
Exposure (bold): her outfit opens to show skin — the neckline opened down to the sternum with natural cleavage, bare forearms, and bare legs above the boots or through a high slit where the silhouette allows; pieces stay symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume above, material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: around 1879, a scientific-instrument maker's workshop: walls of brass-framed barometers and thermometers with silver columns rising and falling, Sprengel vacuum pumps where beads of mercury drip down long glass tubes to empty the first electric light bulbs, a glassblower's bench with a blue flame.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: bright warm sunlight with soft sky light bounced from white clouds.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Hg) and atomic number (80) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish, armor plates, cape, modern plastic, sci-fi.

Detailed original design for this image:
Chosen original design: a Victorian naval officer silhouette, tailored long officer coat with double rows of brass buttons and high boots, boldly open at the neckline, bare arms below rolled sleeves and short fitted skirt. A woman of twenty-eight with a compact heart-shaped face, amber narrow almond eyes, neat straight brows and a composed playful smile. Flowing liquid-quicksilver hair in a long loose asymmetric braid with side bangs, mirror droplets at its silver tips. Colours quicksilver silver, cinnabar vermilion red, lacquer black and minute blue-violet glints. Signature structural idea: the long divided coat tails are built as narrow glass-channel hems enclosing silver columns, terminating in rounded mercury-drop silver weights, like wearable barometers; Victorian cloth tailoring remains obvious, no armour. No objects in either natural human hand. She faces the viewer beside a wall of brass-framed barometers in the 1879 instrument workshop, a mercury-drop Sprengel pump and empty glass lamp bulbs behind her. Sunlight fills the scene. Adult slender-limbed full-busted narrow waist and rounded hips.
